card.name: "of" in antibiotic warning phrases
card.fires_on: The word "of" in fixed label phrases, mainly "alters the normal flora of the colon" and "other members of the cephalosporin class".

modes.label: Normal flora of the colon
modes.description: "of" after "normal flora" in the colitis warning for antibacterial agents.
modes.example: Treatment with antibacterial agents alters the normal flora<< of>> the colon leading to overgrowth of C

modes.label: Members of the class
modes.description: "of" after "other members" in contraindications about cephalosporin hypersensitivity.
modes.example: AINDICATIONS Ceftaroline fosamil for injection is contraindicated in patients with known serious hypersensitivity to ceftaroline or other members<< of>> the cephalosporin class.

card.writes: It promotes dash and hyphen tokens and suppresses words like "as" and "for", which hints at pushing toward punctuation over ordinary continuations.
card.plain: It lights up on the word "of" in stock antibiotic label sentences such as "normal flora of the colon".
